stories/is-november-bitcoins-best-month/.title: Is November Bitcoin's best month since 2010? | Virtuse Brief
stories/is-november-bitcoins-best-month/.description: November's average Bitcoin return since 2010 is +34.4%, but the median is +8.5% (fourth of twelve). February leads by median at +11.7%. See every month.

sk/stories/je-november-najlepsi-mesiac-p.title: Je november najlepší mesiac pre Bitcoin? | Virtuse Brief
sk/stories/je-november-najlepsi-mesiac-p.description: Priemerný výnos Bitcoinu v novembri od roku 2010 je +34,4 %. Medián +8,5 % je štvrtý z dvanástich mesiacov. Podľa mediánu vedie február s +11,7 %.
